business_scope.primary_industry_name: Global Employer of Record and Cross-Border Contractor Payroll

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English-derived, unitary national jurisdiction with no sub-state fiscal distinction; statutes codified in the Laws of Belize)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Belize-United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force since 1985)
CARICOM-Cuba Trade and Economic Cooperation Agreement
United States Caribbean Basin Trade Partnership Act (CBTPA) trade preference framework

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: The Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act, Chapter 104, Laws of Belize, as amended; the International Business Companies Act, Chapter 270, as amended (including the 2020 revisions requiring beneficial ownership records and filings); the Beneficial Ownership (Companies and International Business Companies) Act, 2023, establishing the central Beneficial Ownership Register at the Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (BCCAR); the International Financial Services Commission Act, Chapter 272; and the Financial Intelligence Unit Act, Chapter 104A.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent authority in the individual's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for parties to the Apostille Convention) OR Consular Legalization (for non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within three months) for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank of the country of residence, notarized by a notary public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter for each UBO and corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Clearing bank in the person's country of business

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing where a UBO is a corporate entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the corporate UBO's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Apostilled Power of Attorney and registered agent engagement letter authorizing the Belize registered agent to act
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: UBOs/board of directors, executed before a notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance / certificate of character for each natural-person UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or criminal record authority of the person's country of residence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence for Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) per the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act and Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Guidance Notes; mandatory screening of UBOs, directors, and EOR clients/payroll beneficiaries against the OFAC Consolidated Sanctions List (SDNs), UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HM Treasury Sanctions List, and domestic designations issued by the Central Bank of Belize and the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit; annual CDD refresh and periodic re-screening at the 'Low_Risk_Standard' AML/CFT risk tier; compliance with FATF Recommendations 10-16 and 22-25 and CFATF mutual evaluation follow-up obligations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (BCCAR) Online Portal (online.bccar.bz) - name reservation, entity search, and incorporation filing administered through licensed registered agents for International Business Companies
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the official legal language for corporate records. All corporate names must be submitted in Latin-script romanization. Non-English names must be accompanied by an English translation/transliteration, and the corporate suffix ('Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Ltd', 'Corp', 'Inc.') must appear in English. Names in non-Roman scripts will not be recognized by the registry and must be romanized; a certified transliteration certificate may be required by BCCAR.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended for a further period upon payment of the applicable fee at the Registrar's discretion; if the reservation lapses, the name returns to the pool and a fresh reservation must be filed. Upon rejection, the applicant (acting through the registered agent) may file a written appeal to the Registrar of Companies within 21 days, setting out grounds of distinctiveness, prior consent, or clerical error. Where rejection arises from a sensitive token, the applicant must obtain prior written approval from the Central Bank of Belize, the International Financial Services Commission, or the relevant ministry before re-filing. Alternative remedy: incorporate under an available name and apply for a change of name under section 21 of the International Business Companies Act. Ultimate remedy: judicial review in the Supreme Court of Belize.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A physical registered office in Belize is mandatory and must be maintained at the office of a licensed registered agent, which serves as the address for service of process and statutory filings. A 'virtual office' is permissible only in the form of the agent-provided registered address; no local operational premises, staff, or physical presence in Belize are required for the foreign-facing global EOR platform. Non-resident ownership, management, and control are expressly permitted under the IBC regime. However, the licensing obligation under the Belize Employment Agencies Act applies to any activity of employment placement or staffing services conducted in or from Belize territory.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for the passive offshore IBC without Belize employees or domestic operations (approx. 2-5% projected annual probability of unannounced on-site inspection at entity level); moderate for the registered agent's client files (approx. 15-30% per annum) under CFATF risk-based AML/CFT supervision; unannounced inspection of the EOR's foreign operational premises is outside the statutory remit of the Belize FIU and BCCAR.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270 (Revised Edition), ss. 5 (incorporation), 7 (articles), 14 (shares), 33 (registered office), 52 (directors)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies Registry, Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, Ministry of Financial Services, Belize City
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation filed under section 7 of the International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the authorized capital is expressed in the Articles of Incorporation, may be in any currency, and no escrow or bank deposit is required before registration
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLVED that the subscriber is admitted as initial shareholder and the subscription of [●] ordinary shares at [●] par value is approved under the International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270.

RESOLVED that the registered office at [registered-agent address], Belize City, Belize, is adopted and the licensed Belize registered agent is appointed.

RESOLVED that [Name] is appointed first director and [Name] is appointed President, Secretary and Treasurer, each to serve until the next annual general meeting, with authority to open bank accounts, enter EOR and staffing contracts, and file licences and returns.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, Belize City / Belize Companies Registry e-Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name clearance application through the Companies Registry online portal together with a signed consent form from a licensed Belize registered agent. Pay the name search fee and obtain the name availability certificate before preparing incorporation documents.
required_dossiers: Beneficial owner identification and KYC/AML form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as confusingly similar, file a secondary name or an appeal with the Registrar within 14 days of the query response.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Belize registered agent and Belize notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation using the statutory form, including the company name, share capital, registered office address, and registered agent. Execute the Articles before the subscriber, and have the signature notarized by a Belize notary or a qualified foreign notary with apostille or consular legalization if executed abroad.
required_dossiers: Valid passport or national ID of each subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry requests clarification, correct the flagged clauses or append a notarized amendment and resubmit within 7 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Articles of Incorporation with the Companies Registry through the registered agent. Pay the official state filing fee of USD 150 using the accepted bank transfer or card portal. Upon approval, the Registry issues the Certificate of Incorporation and the tax-exempt certificate for the IBC.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of government fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried, submit a written response to the Registry within 14 days, attaching any amended documents and a correction letter from the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Governance Setup and Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Belize registered agent office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first meeting of the sole or first director and adopt the pro-forma first board resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption, and officer appointments. Issue share certificates, open the shareholders register, directors register, and charges register, and maintain a company seal if required by the Articles.
required_dossiers: Register of shareholders and share certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the corporate records are found incomplete during a compliance review, file a rectification resolution with the registered agent and, where required, a corrected annual return with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Licensing and Occupational Clearances for Belize Physical Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Belize Trade and Investment Development Service (BELTRAIDE), Local Town or City Board, Department of the Environment, Belize National Fire Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a business licence under the Business Licences Act and, as applicable, an employment agency licence through the Labour Department. Secure fire safety certification and building occupancy clearance for the office premises. Since the operation is an administrative staffing office with no industrial process, file a registration or exemption notice with the Department of the Environment rather than a full environmental impact assessment.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Articles of Incorporation
Lease agreement for the Belize office
Building occupancy or structural load confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any license is refused, the company may appeal in writing to the issuing authority or the Minister responsible within 21 days; re-inspection or supplementary AML and payroll process documents may be submitted to cure compliance gaps.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Labour Department, Ministry of Labour, Local Government and Rural Development; Belize Trade and Investment Development Service (BELTRAIDE)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Private Employment Agency Licence and Business Licence under the Business Licences Act, Cap. 291

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment, Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from full EIA; administrative office use requires only an environmental registration or exemption notice under the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or point-source VOCs are generated; sanitary effluent must comply with municipal sewer standards, solid waste must be disposed through licensed waste haulers under the Solid Waste Management Authority, and any emergency generator must comply with EPA emissions limits

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Belize National Fire Service; structural load and occupancy inspection by the Belize Building Authority; occupational health, ergonomics, and first-aid compliance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act, Cap. 337

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Service Department (part of the Ministry of Finance) is the national tax administrator for VAT, income tax, business tax, and stamp duties; e-services are transacted through the official portal at https://etax.taxservice.gov.bz, with primary administrative guidance published at https://www.taxservice.gov.bz.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Business Company (IBC) organized under the Belize International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270) is not automatically issued a domestic TIN or VAT number because the entity enjoys a statutory exemption from Belize income tax, business tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, and stamp duty. The IBC's primary statutory identifier is the certificate of incorporation issued by the Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry through a licensed registered agent. If a TIN or VAT ID is required for operational reasons such as opening a local bank account or executing a local services contract, the foreign enterprise must file a Business Taxpayer Application with the Belize Tax Service Department, submitting the IBC certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, a board resolution authorizing the local application, copies of the register of directors and shareholders, due diligence documentation on the ultimate beneficial owners, and a letter from the registered agent confirming the IBC's exempt status. The Tax Service Department will assign a tax identification number flagged as 'IBC Exempt' without admitting the entity to domestic taxability. No minimum capital contribution or local physical presence is required to complete the registration procedure for this exempt classification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (statutory exemption for International Business Companies). Income, gains, and profits derived from sources outside Belize fall entirely outside the Belizean tax net, and the IBC is generally not treated as a Belize tax resident. The exemption is valid for a fixed statutory period of 50 years from date of incorporation, subject to compliance with annual registry filings and any applicable economic substance reporting obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Belize does not maintain an elective check-the-box regime comparable to United States Treasury Regulations, and the IBC Act does not allow an IBC to elect pass-through taxation while retaining its exempt IBC character. However, an IBC may elect to convert into a domestic Belize company by resolution and approval of the Financial Secretary and the Registrar; such conversion cancels the IBC tax exemption and makes the entity liable to domestic income tax on worldwide income. An IBC may also voluntarily register for Belize VAT where it intends to make taxable supplies within Belize, and may elect to adopt formal international financial reporting standards for substance presentation. Hybrid mismatch elections are not separately provided for in domestic legislation; nevertheless, an IBC may make a procedural election to apply the Economic Substance (Implementation) instructions for calendar-year reporting to preserve documented economic substance in a non-tax-privileged manner.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) administered under the Value Added Tax Act of Belize; the system is a destination-based consumption tax administered by the Belize Tax Service Department.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZD 75,000 (Belize dollars) of annual taxable turnover in any consecutive twelve-month period. A foreign entity exclusively conducting an exempt IBC operation without domestic supplies is not required to register; once the entity commences a local taxable supply of goods or services, the BZD 75,000 threshold applies and the entity must file a VAT registration application within 21 days of exceeding the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Belize has not introduced a real-time electronic invoicing clearance mandate, government fiscal stamping, or API-based transaction reporting as of the applicable assessment period. Taxable persons are required to issue standard sequential VAT invoices containing prescribed information, retain delivery documentation, and transmit VAT returns via the Belize Tax Service electronic filing portal. There is no pre-clearance or real-time transaction authorization requirement under the current indirect tax framework.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available on the export of goods where export is evidenced by customs documentation. For services, zero-rating applies where the recipient of the supply belongs outside Belize and the direct benefit and economic enjoyment of the service occurs outside Belize. In the context of a global Employer of Record and cross-border contractor payroll platform, payroll processing, employment compliance, and contractor management services provided to non-Belizean clients will qualify for the zero rate only where the service is not consumed or used within Belize, the consideration is received in foreign currency, and the supplier retains documentation demonstrating performance of payroll and EOR obligations for offshore workforces. Services supplied to a Belizean resident or services with beneficial use in Belize remain subject to the standard 12.5% VAT rate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CUS-EXP) issued by the Belize Customs Department, required when the EOR operation includes physical export of goods, software media, or contract equipment; not applicable to pure service supply.
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing actual export movement, retained for goods-based transactions or hybrid goods-and-services arrangements.

Inward Remittance Certificate issued by an authorized foreign exchange dealer in Belize demonstrating that the foreign currency consideration for the zero-rated export has entered the Belize financial system.
VAT zero-rated invoice reflecting the taxation supply category, the supplier's VAT registration number, a statement that the supply is zero-rated, and the statutory invoice particulars.
Documentation of the recipient's non-resident status, including a certificate of tax residence, foreign company registry extract, or equivalent evidence that the client belongs outside Belize.
Executed service agreement, payroll registers, contractor time records, and disbursement reports evidencing that the EOR services were enjoyed wholly outside Belize.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are subject to post-clearance audit by the Belize Tax Service Department, with a heightened statutory examination of EOR arrangements based on the apparent mismatch between Belize-domiciled invoicing and foreign workforces. Where zero-rating is incorrectly claimed, the authority may retroactively assess VAT for a period of up to three years, extended to six years in cases of deliberate concealment or false documentation. Interest accrues at the rate of 20% per annum, and civil penalties may reach 100% of the tax evaded; criminal prosecution may additionally expose directors, officers, and the registered agent to fines up to BZD 10,000 and imprisonment. For an IBC, proof of fraudulent export zero-rating or submission of false statements in continuing registration filings triggers loss of the statutory tax exemption, immediate strike-off risk by the Registrar, and retroactive cancellation of the IBC's tax-exempt certificate.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Belize (CBB) under the Central Bank of Belize Act (Cap. 262), administering the Exchange Control Act (Cap. 247) and Exchange Control Regulations; Financial Services Commission of Belize (FSC) supervises licensed financial services auxiliary to the banking function.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Belize Dollar (BZD) operates a hard peg of US$1 = BZ$2.00 (in effect since 1976), with the CBB maintaining full convertibility through authorised dealers. The Exchange Control Act restricts residents; however, an International Business Company is statutorily exempt under section 22 of the IBC Act (Cap. 270), subject to the condition that it does not carry on business with Belize residents. Consequently, the EOR IBC can freely receive client payroll funding, hold USD/EUR accounts, and remit fees or dividends without CBB capital-account permits. Profit remittance is untaxed under the IBC tax-exemption regime and faces no exchange-control gate; bank-level AML filters and internal remittance caps remain the only practical hurdles.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Resident goods exporters must repatriate proceeds to an authorised dealer within 180 days and convert the BZD equivalent at the official peg unless CBB retention approval is obtained. A non-resident IBC conducting global EOR payroll services is not a 'resident exporter' and enjoys the section 22 IBC Act exchange-control exemption; no mandatory surrender or conversion of payroll collections applies. The IBC must, however, ensure zero BZD-denominated transactions with Belize residents, as any such activity would trigger surrender obligations and nullify the exemption.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Account / Client-Funds Escrow Sub-Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-Low. Belize is outside the SEPA reachable jurisdiction list and is deprioritised by most UK/FCA and EU-regulated EMI providers (Revolut Business, Payoneer, MultiPass), which treat Belizean IBCs as elevated-risk due to legacy IBC opacity and EU/OECD listing history. Wise is functionally viable only as a last-mile payout overlay for low-value contractor disbursements, not as the primary settlement spine, because Wise does not issue BZD-resident local account details and cannot independently onboard a Belize IBC without a referenced commercial bank relationship. Recommended architecture: a Belize commercial-bank USD settlement account as the backbone; Wise (or comparable EMI) as a secondary payout leg only, segregated from client funds and subject to a hard treasury flow cap.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Purely remote onboarding is uncommon and institution-specific. Under the CBB AML/CFT Guidelines, Belize banks apply a risk-based approach; for a non-resident IBC, the signatory director and ultimate beneficial owner are ordinarily required to complete an in-person or live video interview, supported by an apostilled board resolution, certified certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, certificate of good standing, register of directors/shareholders, UBO register extract, and passport/proof-of-address notarisation. The practical default is one executive visit to Belize City for the account-opening interview and a 4-8 week onboarding window; use of a licensed Belize registered agent for document certifcation shortens the timeline.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: IBC structure perceived as opaque: nominee directors, legacy bearer-share concessions, or an untraceable UBO chain triggering reputational-risk decline at the account-opening committee.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified incorporation documents; full UBO register with passport, proof of residence, and source-of-wealth narrative for each natural person; register of directors and shareholders; formal no-bearer-share declaration; due-diligence certificate from a licensed FSC registered agent; economic-substance memorandum evidencing real operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Projected high-velocity payroll flows: 500+ small-amount credits monthly to beneficiaries across multiple countries, misinterpreted as layering, structuring, or client-money misuse.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed global master services agreement; EOR service description and contractor/employment agreements; monthly payroll registers and client bill-back invoices; auditable segregation of client funds report generated by the payroll platform; independent accountant's confirmation of the payroll operating model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Correspondent-bank chain decline attributable to Belize's prior inclusion on EU/OECD sanctioned-jurisdiction monitoring lists and integrity scoring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Proof of local substance (leased office, local compliance officer, registered agent); CBB-compliant AML/CFT policies; Belize legal opinion confirming tax-exempt and section 22 IBC Act exchange-control status; three-year projected financials demonstrating a genuine EOR platform rather than a passthrough shell.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection sourced from a high-risk jurisdiction, third-party funding, or crypto-adjacent rails, blocking the pre-onboarding compliance gate.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-wealth statement supported by 12 months of shareholder bank statements; parent company corporate register extract; notarised declaration of no asset-freeze proceedings; confirmation that the originating institution is an OECD-licensed credit intermediary sending via SWIFT MT103.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All external funds must arrive via SWIFT MT103 from an OECD-licensed credit institution into the IBC's USD settlement account in Belize; no CBB exchange-control approval is required for the IBC exemption, but payment narratives must carry explicit purpose descriptors such as 'Capital Contribution - Belize IBC incorporation', 'Pre-seed funding for Global EOR implementation', or 'Client payroll prepayment under MS-2024-xxx', together with the payer's LEI where available. The receiving bank's compliance unit will request the corporate resolution authorising the capital increase, share-allotment confirmation from the Belize registered agent, and a directors' attestation that none of the funds derive from Belize resident activities; USD balances remain unexposed to conversion spread due to the fixed 2:1 peg.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails are structured in four tiers: (i) primary settlement via SWIFT MT103 from the Belize USD account to an international payroll aggregator or partner bank; (ii) local payroll direct debit executed through in-country payroll entities or licensed processors using ACH/SEPA/local instant rails; (iii) Wise Direct for low-value contractor payouts as a supplemental last-mile rail; and (iv) commercial letters of credit, which are inapplicable to an EOR services book and would be rejected by the bank's trade desk as goods-trade instruments unsuited to operational staffing floats.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forwards on USD/EUR, USD/GBP and USD/CAD with tenors up to 12 months, executed with a Belize-licensed commercial bank or OECD-regulated counterparty for payroll-rate certainty.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on illiquid regional currencies including BZD and other Caribbean floaters, capped at one-month of payroll exposure to fix conversion cost for tail-currency payout books.

Cross-currency swaps and rolling forward structures limited to a notional ceiling of three months of forecast payroll liabilities, preserving hedging character and avoiding speculative classification under the IBC treasury policy.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: IBC Annual Return (prescribed form under IBC Act, Cap. 270, s.129)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Belize
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after each incorporation anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty BZD 200 (USD 100) per late return; continued default triggers gazetted strike-off notice and deregistration with asset vesting in the Crown

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Fee / IBC Renewal (IBC Act, Cap. 270, s.110)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Belize
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the incorporation anniversary date annually
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% per annum interest on unpaid fee; non-payment for 12 months authorizes administrative strike-off and loss of legal capacity

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent in Belize (confirmation maintained at registered office and produced to Registrar on demand)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Co-terminous with annual return; confirmation signed within 3 months after incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to BZD 10,000 (USD 5,000) and potential criminal penalty for false confirmation; agent flags non-confirmation to the Registrar

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Exempt for a standard Belize IBC under Cap. 270; mandatory independent audit applies only where the entity holds an IFSC licence (money services, fiduciary, or investment business) or where the employment agency licence conditions require audited financial statements; EOR payroll volume alone does not trigger audit
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS for regulated entities; IBC Act requires adequate accounting records reflecting daily receipts, expenditures, and financial position, prepared under IFRS or US GAAP

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Registered agent obtains an annual beneficial ownership declaration; every share transfer is screened and the segregated UBO Register updated at the Belize registered office; material UBO changes are notified to the agent within 14 days of occurrence
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Beneficial Owners (segregated, held at registered office)
Minute Book and corporate seal records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 (statutorily exempt) or USD 3,500 - USD 8,000 where IFSC licensing or license condition imposes an independent audit

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 1.75% Business Tax on gross receipts (general non-retail corporate rate under the Income and Business Tax Act, Cap. 55, Laws of Belize). A residual 25% Income Tax applies to corporate investment income and items not within the Business Tax net. Belize International Business Companies (IBCs) in good standing remain exempt on foreign-source income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective zero rate on foreign-source dividends, interest, royalties, and capital gains for a qualifying IBC that does not carry on business with Belize residents and does not derive Belize-source income. No capital gains tax, no gift or inheritance tax, no exchange control. Export-oriented undertakings may obtain incentives under the Fiscal Incentives Act, but a global EOR payroll agency has no specific payroll tax holiday.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Business Tax Return (TSD Form BT-1) filed electronically through the Belize Tax Services Department (TSD) e-Services portal (https://etax.taxservices.gov.bz). The non-resident owner files through a licensed Belizean registered agent holding the IBC's Taxpayer Registration Number (TRN).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly; quarterly filing is available for businesses with monthly gross receipts below BZD 25,000.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Monthly: on or before the 15th day of the succeeding month. Quarterly: on or before 15 April, 15 July, 15 October, and 15 January following each quarter end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer Registration Number of the Belize IBC
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident operator must obtain the TRN through its Belize registered agent before any filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calendar month or quarter covered by the return
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Align with the IBC fiscal year end disclosed to the Registry to avoid mismatched assessments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income from Belize-source business activity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Belize-source gross receipts; foreign EOR payroll fees are separately declared on the exemption schedule and are not taxable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign-source income claimed as exempt under the IBC regime
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a schedule identifying client jurisdictions and payroll amounts; omission triggers assessment at 1.75% on worldwide receipts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Box 3 multiplied by the applicable Business Tax rate
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use 1.75% for general services. A 6% retail rate would taint the IBC status and should never be applied to EOR fees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: PAYE income tax withheld from Belize-resident workers and Social Security contributions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IBC that employs Belize residents risks domestic taint; if unavoidable, attach the WT-1 reconciliation and Social Security schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net Business Tax payable after prior credits and installments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay in Belize dollars from a local bank account; foreign-currency remittance via Wise is not a recognized payment rail for TSD.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment: 10% surcharge on the unpaid tax plus interest of 1% per month (approximately 12.68% effective annual rate). Failure to file: administrative fine up to BZD 1,000, best-of-judgment assessment by the Commissioner, and distraint or court proceedings for continued default.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return (TSD Form CT-1) filed through the TSD e-Services portal. Used by IBCs to reconcile exempt foreign-source income, claim credits for Business Tax paid, and declare non-business investment income.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before 15 March following the end of the calendar or approved fiscal year; a filing extension to 30 June may be granted by the TSD on written application.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total assessable income and exemption claims
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim the IBC exemption for foreign-source payroll service fees and interest income; attach jurisdictional breakdown.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credit for Business Tax already paid on gross receipts
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach copies of Form BT-1 filings and TSD receipts to prevent double taxation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual PAYE and Social Security declaration for EOR workers
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If no Belize-resident workers are employed, file a nil schedule to evidence no domestic taint.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign withholding taxes suffered on interest and royalties
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim treaty relief only where a DTA applies, currently the Belize-UK Convention; attach foreign tax vouchers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cross-border intercompany fees, payroll reimbursements, and management charges
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No statutory threshold, but file a voluntary Local File where intercompany flows exceed BZD 1,000,000 per year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Director or authorized officer signature evidencing management and control
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Belize-resident director or manager must sign; the registered agent cannot sign as a substitute.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 10% penalty on the tax shown, interest at 1% monthly, and director fines up to BZD 1,000. Deliberate false statements: 100% penalty on the evaded tax and imprisonment up to 5 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IBC Annual Return and License Fee (Registry Form IBC-AR) filed with the Registry of Companies in Belize City; administered electronically through the Registrar's portal or by the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the anniversary date of incorporation. License fee bands depend on authorized share capital and must be paid to maintain good standing and the foreign-source exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, incorporation number, date of incorporation, and registered office in Belize
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office must be a physical address in Belize; a post office box is not acceptable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current register of directors and shareholders
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee directors must be supported by a beneficial ownership declaration naming the ultimate non-resident principal.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of the licensed registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent will resign if the IBC fails to supply economic substance information or accounting records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address where accounting records and underlying payroll records are kept
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Records must be kept in Belize at the registered office or at another notified location; offshore-only records breach the IBC Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual government fee: approximately BZD 200 for authorized capital up to 50,000 shares; BZD 700 up to 50,000,000 shares; BZD 2,000 above 50,000,000 shares
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the current fee schedule with the registered agent; the fee is a condition precedent to claiming the tax exemption.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file or pay within 3 months triggers automatic strike-off, forfeiture of assets to the Crown, and a restoration application with penalties up to BZD 1,000 plus the Registrar's restoration fee. Directors are personally liable for IBC debts contracted while struck off.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Belize does not impose withholding tax on dividend distributions, whether paid to resident or non-resident shareholders, and whether in cash or in shares.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Belize has only one comprehensive double taxation agreement in force: the Belize-United Kingdom Convention (entered into force in 2017). Protocol to invoke treaty relief: (1) the beneficial owner obtains a UK certificate of residence from HMRC (Form DT or equivalent); (2) the Belize payer or the IBC submits a claim for relief to the TSD with the certificate, a beneficial ownership declaration, and the underlying contract within 60 days of the payment; (3) for UK-source interest or royalties paid to the Belize IBC, the payer in the UK applies the reduced treaty rate at source and the Belize TSD grants a matching foreign tax credit on the CT-1. Because Belize has no dividend WHT, the treaty protocol is practically relevant only to interest and royalties. The CARICOM Double Taxation Agreement has not been brought into effect for Belize and provides no enforceable relief.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 25% on Belize-sourced royalties and interest paid to non-residents. Treaty rates under the Belize-UK Convention: 15% maximum on interest and 15% maximum on royalties. Interest and royalties that are attributable to the foreign-source business of a Belize IBC remain exempt under the IBC regime and attract no WHT. Global EOR platform fees received from foreign clients are foreign-source and do not generate WHT in Belize.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Belize has no statutory Local File or Master File thresholds. The Commissioner may re-determine related-party pricing under section 5(4) of the Income and Business Tax Act and the general anti-avoidance rule. Best-practice threshold: prepare and retain a Local File where intercompany transactions, including salary pass-through, management fees, and EOR margin charges, exceed BZD 1,000,000 (approximately USD 500,000) per year. Prepare a Master File where the multinational group reports consolidated turnover above BZD 750,000,000, the OECD country-by-country reporting threshold adopted in Belize's international tax commitments. In practice, a 5% to 15% mark-up on payroll pass-through for a low-risk EOR agent is considered arm's length where the Belize IBC assumes no market, credit, or employment risk.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270, as amended in 2018 and 2019, together with the Income and Business Tax Act, imposes economic substance requirements aligned with EU and OECD standards. A Belize IBC conducting relevant activities, including distribution, service center, financing, and intellectual property holding, must demonstrate in Belize: (i) a physical office and premises; (ii) board meetings and strategic management; (iii) adequate employees and operational expenditure proportionate to the activity; and (iv) core income-generating activities performed in Belize. A global EOR staffing platform routed through a Belize IBC must maintain at least one Belize-resident director, a local payroll compliance officer, and a registered agent with full accounting records. A paper IBC without substance will lose the foreign-source exemption, be reclassified as a domestic taxable company at 1.75% Business Tax on worldwide gross receipts, and be denied treaty benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and False Business Tax Filings
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of gross receipts, diversion of EOR fees to undisclosed offshore personal accounts, or issuance of fake payroll invoices for workers not actually employed or supplied by the Belize IBC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Best-of-judgment assessment of the full understated tax; penalty of 100% of the evaded tax; interest at 1% per month; criminal fines up to BZD 10,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years under the Income and Business Tax Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax arrears and penalties where they signed false returns or directed the fraud; civil restitution orders, travel bans, and seizure of personal assets are available to the TSD.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Economic Substance Breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IBC as a paper entity with no physical office in Belize, no resident employees, no board minutes, and no accounting records while claiming the foreign-source exemption on millions of dollars of EOR payroll processing fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off from the Registry after 3 months of default on the annual return; restoration penalty up to BZD 1,000; retrospective reassessment of worldwide receipts at 1.75% Business Tax plus 10% late surcharge; denial of benefits under the Belize-UK treaty.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally responsible for debts incurred during the struck-off period, for reinstatement filings, and for any misrepresentation made to the Registrar; directors may be disqualified for up to 5 years and barred from serving on any Belize company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML, Money Laundering, and Beneficial Ownership Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing client payroll through Wise or local direct debit without identifying the underlying workers and without maintaining a beneficial ownership register; accepting payroll funds without filing suspicious transaction reports; concealing the true non-resident principal behind nominee shareholders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act and the Beneficial Ownership Act 2020: fines up to BZD 500,000 and imprisonment up to 14 years; asset freezing orders, confiscation orders, and compulsory liquidation of the IBC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and registered agents face personal fines, travel bans, and imprisonment; the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit may blacklist the company and its principals, triggering correspondent bank account closures and reputational collapse.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Prohibited Domestic Trade and Unlicensed EOR Activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Belize IBC physically employs Belize-resident workers, supplies staff to clients operating inside Belize, maintains a fixed place of business in Belize for local services, or operates as an employment agency without the required license under the Labour Act and without Social Security registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The IBC Act prohibits an IBC from carrying on business with Belize residents except for prescribed offshore functions. Sanctions include deemed conversion to a domestic company, retrospective assessment at 1.75% to 6% Business Tax plus 25% Income Tax on local profits, license fines up to BZD 5,000, closure orders, and mandatory unpaid wage restitution to placed workers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are individually and jointly liable for unpaid wages and statutory fines of locally placed workers; they face immigration exclusion from Belize, imprisonment for illegal placement of foreign workers, and personal liability for all contracts entered into in violation of the IBC Act.
